name: Hardware Verified
status: trial: Hardware Verified is a trial feature. It may change or be removed.
description: Arcade games on the MisterZine release tracker whose core was built and checked against the real board or its schematics: an owned or borrowed PCB, PAL/PROM dumps, the original schematics, logic analyzer or scope captures, or a published write-up of how the logic was derived from the board. Verified means built and checked against the real hardware, not that every behavior was tested. Positive only: a game without an entry means nothing. Entries are curated by hand from public, checkable evidence of that work, from the core's author or anyone else who did or documented it, and each lists the links it rests on.

fields.k: the release tracker's row key: the k field of releases/data.json and the #k deep link (https://misterzine.fyi/releases/#k)
fields.title: the game's title on the tracker when the entry was made (informational; titles can change, the key does not)
fields.rbfs: the shipped core file name(s) without the date stamp and .rbf extension (data.json core)
fields.setnames: the MAME set name(s) of the row (data.json sn)
fields.granted: the day the entry was added, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.proposed_by: who proposed the entry (anyone; 'misterzine' for entries added by the tracker itself)
fields.reason: what the evidence shows, in plain words
fields.links: the evidence: public pages citing the concrete hardware work (the core's author's or anyone else's)

badges.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalker

badges.title: ASO - Armored Scrum Object

badges.title: Jackal

badges.title: Computer Space

badges.title: Klax

badges.title: Star Wars

badges.title: Pong
